en.bdb: Truth is the test of a Guru

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੁਤੁ ਜਣੈ ਵੜਿ ਕੋਠੜੀ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਜਗੁ ਜਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: put janai vaR koThaRee baahar jag jaanai|

en.bdb: A son is given birth in a closed room but all the people outside come to know of it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਧਰਤੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਦਬੀਐ ਮਸਤਕੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: dhan dharatee vich dhabeeaai masatak paravaanai|

en.bdb: The wealth even buried in the earth is revealed through facial expressions of the owner.
Even an ordinary passerby can tell that it has already rained.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਸੀਸੁ ਨਿਵਾਇਦਾ ਚੜੑਹਿਐ ਚੰਦ੍ਰਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: sabh ko sees nivaidhaa chaR(h)hiaai cha(n)dhraanai|

en.bdb: All bow towards it as the new moon rises.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੋਰਖ ਦੇ ਗਲਿ ਗੋਦੜੀ ਜਗੁਨਾਥੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: gorakh dhe gal godhaRee jagunaath vakhaanai|

en.bdb: Gorakh has a patched blanket around his neck but the world knows him as nath, the great master.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਚੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਸਚਿ ਸਚੁ ਸਿਞਾਣੈ ॥੨੦॥
verses.translit_en: gur parachai gur aakheeaai sach sach sin(j)aanai ||20||

en.bdb: Knowledge of the Guru is called the Guru; only the truth identifies the truth.
